fieldValues.title: Stages earn autonomy by measured acceptance
fieldValues.move: Give each stage a trust level (every output checked, a sample checked, trusted) that moves up only when the maintainer's acceptance rate on that stage clears a stated bar for a stated number of runs, and drops back on a miss.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not make a stage's work better; it decides how much of it a person looks at. A rare, serious error can pass while a stage is sampled.
fieldValues.falsifier: A stage promoted to sampled or trusted produces an error a reader finds that the maintainer's check would have caught, more than once in a period.
fieldValues.return_when: Most stages sit at trusted and errors come from new kinds of source: attention should move to the sources, not the stages.
